name: Start
description: Entry point of a workflow. Every flow requires exactly one. Compiles to a Void start marker.

name: Human in the Loop
description: Hand the flow to a person: open a conversation from a context-built prompt and collect their answers, either parking the run until they are done or recording the task and carrying on. Compiles to an Extrinsic on the hitl service (svc.hitl.add).

name: Doc Store
description: Search or upsert documents in a referenced document store. Compiles to an Extrinsic on svc.store.doc.{ACTION}.

name: Vector Store
description: Search or upsert into a referenced vector store. Compiles to an Extrinsic on svc.store.vec.{ACTION}.

name: Wait for All
description: Fan-in / join point that waits for every inbound branch. Compiles to a Void node depending on all inbound nodes.

name: LLM
description: Call a language model with a prompt template and bound functions (each a routed output). Compiles to a Plugin node.

name: MCP
description: Connect to an MCP server as a client (url / auth / transport), exposing its tools. Compiles to a Plugin node.

name: Rule
description: Branch on a rule (JavaScript or OPA/Rego) and route through matching handlers. Compiles to a Contract.

name: JS
description: Run a JavaScript step against the scoped context. Compiles to a Code node (variant js).

name: OPA
description: Evaluate an OPA/Rego policy against the scoped context. Compiles to a Code node (variant opa).

name: Goto
description: Jump to a node in another (or the same) workflow. Compiles to a GoTo.

name: Continue After
description: Park the flow and resume its outbound nodes at a scheduled time. Compiles to an Extrinsic on svc.continue.at.

name: Cast / Mapping
description: Map target keys to static values or JSONPaths resolved at run time. Compiles to a Plugin node.

name: HTTP
description: Make HTTP requests to external APIs. Compiles to a Plugin node.
